sections.title: Part 1 · Vocabulary test
sections.sub: Chọn hoặc điền từ / cụm từ đã học.

items.prompt: “rộng rãi” in English is…
The market is in a ____ area. There are always lots of people.
My apartment is centrally ____. It is in the city centre.
I have a ____ neighbour. She always says hello.
There are lots of ____ facilities: a gym, a park and a café.
“yên bình” in English is…
The gym has modern ____.
My home is in a ____ location. The bus stop is very near.

sections.title: Part 2 · Reading — Hoa's neighbourhood
sections.sub: Đọc đoạn văn rồi trả lời câu hỏi.
sections.passage:
Hoa lives in a spacious apartment in a peaceful neighbourhood. Her apartment isn't centrally located, but it's in a convenient location. There is a bus stop near her building, and it takes her fifteen minutes to get to the city centre by bus.

There are lots of nearby facilities. There is a supermarket, a small café and a gym with modern facilities. There isn't a hospital near her home, but there is a big hospital in the city centre.

One thing Hoa likes is her neighbour, Mrs Lan. She is a very friendly neighbour, and she always says hello in the morning.

The only problem is the market. It's in a crowded area, and it is very crowded at weekends. Hoa usually goes to the park on Sundays because it's very peaceful.

sections.title: Part 3 · Listening — Linh's neighbourhood
sections.sub: Nghe và trả lời. Script hiện ra sau khi nộp bài.

items.prompt: Where does Linh live?
Where is the big supermarket?
There are ____ cafés.
Why is Linh's home convenient?
options: There is a hospital near it.
There are two bus stops near it.
answers: There are two bus stops near it.
items.show: There are two bus stops near it.

items.prompt: Why is the park peaceful?
Linh's friendly neighbour is called ____.
Is there a hospital near Linh's home?
What does Ben like about his neighbourhood?

sections.audioHint: Bài nghe dài ~2 phút. Nghe 2 lần rồi trả lời.
script: Hi Linh! Is this your neighbourhood?
Yes, it is. Welcome! It's a peaceful neighbourhood, and it's centrally located.
It's really peaceful. Do you live in an apartment or a house?
I live in a spacious apartment near the park.
That's great. Is there a supermarket near your apartment?
Yes, there is. There's a big supermarket near the bus stop.
Are there any nearby facilities, like a gym?
Yes, there are lots of nearby facilities. There's a gym with modern facilities, and there are two cafés.
Yes, it is. It's convenient because there are two bus stops near my home.
What do you like about the area?
One thing I like is the park. It's peaceful because there are lots of trees.
And what are your neighbours like?
I have a friendly neighbour. Her name is Mai, and she's very nice.
Is there a hospital near here?
No, there isn't. However, there's a school and a market.
Is there anything you don't like?
The only problem is the market. It's a crowded area at weekends.
I see. My neighbourhood is very different. It's a crowded area, and there aren't any parks.
Oh no! So what do you like about it?
One thing I like is my apartment. It's small, but it's centrally located, so it's convenient.
Then come to my neighbourhood at weekends. The park is very peaceful!

sections.title: Part 4 · Speaking — Shadowing
sections.sub: Nghe mẫu → đọc theo → ghi âm. Máy chấm điểm trên thang 10 và tô màu từng từ.

items.prompt: Describe your neighbourhood

sentences.text: I live in a spacious apartment in a peaceful neighbourhood.
It's centrally located, so it's very convenient.
There is a big supermarket near my home, and there are two bus stops nearby.
There are lots of nearby facilities, like a gym and a café.
One thing I like is my friendly neighbour.
The only problem is the market. It's a crowded area at weekends.
